_readme: Copy this file to models.json in this folder (or point PRISM_MODELS_CONFIG at any path), edit, then restart pm2 prism-server. No models.json = Prism behaves exactly as before. Plain-language guide: MODELS.md at the repo root. Keys starting with _ are comments.

providers._readme: A provider = a kind + where to reach it. 'model' is the default when a job names only the provider. API keys: name the ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE in api_key_env (set it in apps/server/.env) — never paste a key here.

claude._readme: The hardened claude CLI runner (signs in with the CLI's own login). The only provider that can run tool-using agent chat today.

local._readme: LM Studio on THIS machine. A loopback address turns on local=true and the memory guard automatically.

ollama._readme: Ollama on THIS machine (its OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint).

workstation._readme: The NVIDIA workstation over Tailscale (vLLM / llama.cpp / Ollama). Not loopback, so say local=true yourself; memory_guard stays off (its memory is not this machine's).

openrouter._readme: Any frontier model through OpenRouter's OpenAI-compatible API. Set OPENROUTER_API_KEY in apps/server/.env.

jobs._readme: Each job lists provider:model in order of preference; the next one is tried when one fails (logged, and shown in GET /api/agent/runner). fallback: any | local-only | none.
